title: Happy bumblebee
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- wings -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#bfe9ff' transform='rotate(-20 38 32)'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='32' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#bfe9ff' transform='rotate(20 62 32)'/>
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#eaf7ff' transform='rotate(-20 38 32)'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='32' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#eaf7ff' transform='rotate(20 62 32)'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#ffcf33'/>
    <!-- stripes -->
    <path d='M27 52 Q50 44 73 52 L73 60 Q50 52 27 60 Z' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
    <path d='M30 68 Q50 60 70 68 L68 76 Q50 68 32 76 Z' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
    <path d='M36 79 Q50 73 64 79 L60 83 Q50 79 40 83 Z' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='15' fill='#ffd84d'/>
    <!-- face highlight -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='11' fill='#ffe98a'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='34' r='3.2' fill='#3b2d6b'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='34' r='3.2' fill='#3b2d6b'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='33' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M44 42 Q50 47 56 42' stroke='#3b2d6b' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ff9a8a'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ff9a8a'/>
    <!-- antennae -->
    <path d='M45 24 Q42 16 38 13' stroke='#3b2d6b' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M55 24 Q58 16 62 13' stroke='#3b2d6b' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='12' r='3' fill='#ff9a8a'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='12' r='3' fill='#ff9a8a'/>
    <!-- stinger -->
    <path d='M50 79 L50 87 L46 80 Z' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
